$schema: Calmido design-system tokens — source of truth. tokens.css is generated from this file via scripts/build-tokens.mjs.

color.comment: Calmido colour tokens (exact values from CSS styles frame)

color.name: blue
color.note: Calmido Blue — headlines, primary ink on light

color.name: dark-blue
color.note: primary ink on light, dark surfaces

color.name: logo-blue
color.note: canonical brand blue — logo art only

color.name: dark-green
color.note: fills only — 2.33:1 on white, never text

color.name: green-ink
color.note: green text, icons and links on light — 5.35:1 on white

color.name: dark-grey
color.note: borders and outlines only — 4.48:1 on white, never text

color.name: grey-ink
color.note: muted text and placeholders on light — 5.72:1 on white, 5.53:1 on light-bg

color.comment: threat scale, low to high. Named for the band, not the hue — the bands are the same score thresholds on all three clients.

color.name: threat-unrated
color.note: no score yet — off the scale rather than on it

color.comment: threat inks: the bright hues above are fills (meter, badges, arcs); text and icons on light use these
caller-card gradients: white ink stays ≥ 4.5:1 along the whole gradient
neutrals observed in canvas (f7f7f8 base, 242 238 237 warm)

font-ink.comment: Re-points to brand colours. Add class="inverse" on a parent to flip all three tokens to their inverse pairs (e.g. on dark surfaces). The dark theme uses the inverse pairs.

theme.comment: Theme roles: "value" is light, "dark" is dark. Components use these, not palette names, so they follow the theme.

theme.name: surface-muted
theme.note: filled chips, tracks; dark keeps ink-danger ≥ 4.5:1

theme.name: border
theme.note: dividers, card edges; dark = iOS divider (#B8B8BA @ 35%)

theme.name: border-strong
theme.note: input borders — ≥ 3:1 on the surface (dark: 3.6:1, as iOS)

theme.name: outline
theme.note: outlined button border, pressed fill; dark = iOS outlined button

theme.name: ink-link
theme.note: always underlined; dark = white, as iOS

theme.name: ink-danger
theme.note: dangerous verdict, errors; dark = iOS alertRed, 4.9:1 on bg-dark

theme.name: placeholder
theme.note: input placeholder — ≥ 4.5:1 on the input surface (dark: 4.8:1 on surface-muted, 5.0:1 on bg-dark, 6.1:1 on surface-raised)

theme.name: edge-shadow
theme.note: 6px band where scrolling content meets a top or bottom bar, fading away from the bar; dark = black 40% over bg-dark

font.comment: Font families — three free / Google Fonts
